name: Shopify Catalog Enrich: Batch -> Filter -> AI -> Sheet

parameters.content:
SHOPIFY CATALOG ENRICHMENT

1. Webhook POST shopify/products/batch
2. Code dedupes by SKU/handle (NO AI yet)
3. Filter: AI ONLY on empty description or title SEO gaps
4. Loop Over Items (batch=5) for AI enrichment
5. Append Catalog_QA sheet status=pending_review

Human QA gate before publishing to Shopify.

options.systemMessage: You are a Shopify catalog copywriter. Generate SEO-optimized title, HTML description, meta description, and suggested tags. Match brand tone for REPLACE_WITH_STORE_NAME. Never invent specs not implied by the input. Return only valid JSON.

jsonSchemaExample.seo_title: Premium Organic Cotton T-Shirt - Soft Everyday Fit
jsonSchemaExample.description_html: Soft organic cotton tee designed for everyday comfort. Breathable fabric, relaxed fit.
jsonSchemaExample.meta_description: Shop our organic cotton t-shirt. Soft, breathable, and perfect for daily wear.
